paragraphs.text: House Verdenth (ver-DENTH) was one of the five powerful houses in Arathoxia , ruled from the forest Krysalthus by Lady Verdenth .

It was also known as House Emerald , after the green Mox , whose location was never revealed. House Verdenth was destroyed in Ravidel’s invasion of Arathoxia, and the Lady herself was killed in a personal duel with Ravidel. Her castle was then obliterated with a blast from the Planar Barge .
The house likely originated on the island of the same name .

Lady Verdenth was a green mana sorceress and mistress of House Verdenth in Arathoxia and lady of the forest of Krysalthus on Corondor . She saved the infant Jared Carthalion in Krysalthus from wolves as Ezer rushed the baby away from the Battle of Aster Fall . She allied with Marshall Bikov during Ravidel 's invasion of Arathoxia , until Ravidel killed her.
